source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Remove all test records with UNKNOWN results, as all test results relate to the SPECIMEN SPECIMEN SAFETY TEST & RECORDS HOLDER below.
3. Identify the SAFETY TEST & RECORDS HOLDER containing the listed failed visual tests and write the unique identifier of the specimen into the first 5 cells of the spreadsheet.
4. Create new rows for each appliance plugged into the failed specimen.
5. Identify the failed tests for each appliance; where an appliance passes all failed tests, do not record the same failed test again for that appliance.
6. Where a test is not recorded for an appliance, for whatever reason, identify that appliance as UNKNOWN.
7. Repeat this process for each specimen.
